UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user digital public identity, authenticated role (citizen, municipal contractor, policymaker/admin), jurisdiction, and contractor licensing information.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID

displayName.description: Full name of the user or contractor representative

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Auth or profile

role.description: System role: civilian (citizen), provider (municipal contractor), policymaker (admin / magistrate), whatsapp (bot)

department.description: Government department, municipal zone, or contractor firm

jurisdiction.description: Ward, Taluk, or District area of authority

contractorFirm.description: Registered contracting agency name if role is provider

contractorLicenseNo.description: Official municipal contractor license or PWD vendor code

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when profile was last updated

Grievance.title: Civic Grievance
Grievance.description: Civic grievance or infrastructure defect report lodged by citizen, field worker, or WhatsApp gateway.

title.description: Concise summary of the civic hazard

originalLanguage.description: Language used when lodging report (e.g., en, ta, hi, kn)

resolutionPhotoUrl.description: Certified completion photo uploaded by authenticated municipal contractor

resolutionNotes.description: Contractor work notes and completion report

resolvedByContractor.description: Contractor name or vendor ID who completed the fix

disputeReason.description: Citizen dispute justification if fix is unsatisfactory

reportedByUid.description: UID of the citizen reporter (or 'anonymous_citizen' if DPI open tier)

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles and credentials indexed by Firebase Auth UID

/grievances/{grievanceId}.description: Persistent civic grievances and infrastructure work orders
